Newest complete lineage wins: the FILE row names that postimage; differential.sh also replays the main-path lineage (identical except the COMPUTED_LIST probe).

# FILE rows: donor path (donor repository root) -> target path (module root m3/ports/precompute). PACKAGE rows: donor package -> target package. TYPE rows: donor type -> target type (identity rows keep the M3* donor names). NEC rows: owners whose equivalence with the relocated family is NOT decided here (module:<path> names an M3JDK owner; nothing copied, nothing changed). OMIT rows: donor files left out by decision (nothing copied; blob pinned in the run log). EXTERNAL rows: third-party packages a donor file imports, kept as they are (the JUnit 5 API, already a test dependency of the module pom). No LITERAL or DROP rows (otherwise java.util, java.security, java.nio.charset and java.util.concurrent only; the one system property m3.stitch.native.required is already M3-named).
